title: Inquiries Regarding The Arrest Of A Suspected Communist Named Zau Loong By The Chinese Authorities

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No.
S. B. D. 2756.
Date Sept. 16, 1931

Subject (in full) Inquiries regarding the arrest of a suspected communist
named Zau Loong ( 趙龍 ) by the Chinese Authorities.

Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Everest

With reference to the endorsement of the
D.C. (Crime) on the attached report, I have to state that
as a result of careful enquiries made by the staff of this
Office, it has been ascertained that the communist suspect
mentioned therein was arrested in Room 66, Yeu Koong ( 月宮 )
Hotel, No. 99 North Szechuen Road, O.O.L.

CCP A.D. Everest.
D. S. I.

A/Officer i/c Special Branch.

Form No. 2
G. 21,500-1-31

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Section B, H.Q., S.I. Branch
S. B. D. 2756.
Date Sept. 17, 31.）

Subject (in full) Assistance to the Soong-Wu Military Headquarters and joint
watch kept at Yuan Yuan Lodging House(源元), 154 Kiukiang Road.

Made by D.S.I. Everest. Forwarded by （签名）

At about 11 a.m. September 14, 1931, Wong Ping(王斌),
1st Class Detective attached to the Soong-Wu Military Headquarters,
came to this office and requested assistance to keep a joint
watch on Room 48, Yuan Yuan Lodging House, 154 Kiukiang Road,
which was suspected of being frequented by Communists.

Wong Ping produced a letter, (attached) obtained by
him from Post Office Box No. 889 as a result of information
obtained during the course of a recent raid in Chinese territory,
which gave the address of the lodging house as the meeting place
to be used by two persons named therein who are suspected of
being Communists.

A joint watch was maintained by this office and the
Chinese Authorities at the above address from 4 p.m. September 14
to 9 p.m. September 15 when it was discontinued at the request
of the Soong-Wu Authorities.

Information has been received that in connection with
this case, a suspect named Zau Loong(趙龍) was arrested by
the Chinese Authorities at 11 a.m. September 15 in Room 66, Yeu
Koong Hotel(月宮), No. 99 North Szechuen Road, O.O.L.
No Communistic literature was found

（批：Suspicious

报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局
总部B科，特别情报分部
S. B. D. 2756.
日期 1931年9月17日。）

事由（全称） 协助宋吴军事指挥部并在九江路154号源元旅馆（Yuan Yuan Lodging House）进行联合监视。

由特别调查员埃弗斯特（Everest）制作。转呈人 （签名）

1931年9月14日上午11时许，隶属宋吴军事指挥部的一级侦探王斌（Wong Ping）来到本办公室，请求协助对九江路154号源元旅馆48号房间进行联合监视，该房间涉嫌有共产主义分子频繁出入。

王斌出示了一封信件（见附件），该信件是他根据近期在中国地界突击搜查中获得的情报，从889号邮政信箱获取的，信中提供了上述旅馆的地址，称其为信中提到的两名疑似共产主义分子将使用的会面地点。

本办公室与中国当局于9月14日下午4时至9月15日晚上9时在上述地址维持联合监视，后应宋吴当局要求停止监视。

据收到的消息，在此案相关行动中，中国当局于9月15日上午11时在老闸捕房辖区（O.O.L.）北四川路99号月宫旅馆（Yeu Koong Hotel）66号房间逮捕了一名名为赵龙（Zau Loong）的嫌疑犯。
未发现共产主义文献

（批注：可疑

page_data.en:
Translation of a letter addressed to Miss Ting Nah
(丁娜女士 ), Post Office Box No.889, dated Sept.10.
---------

WE have not seen each other for more than two years.
It might be possible that you have forgotten me entirely
as we were not on very intimate terms when we were at school
together.

Upon my arrival in Shanghai, my friend "Siau" ( 肖 ),
Author of the "International" and member of Chi Tsoong (?)
( 暨中 ), told me of your address and informed me that you
were interested in modern Chinese literature, and as I know
something about this, I am very anxious to have a hearty
talk on the subject. I have no fixed abode but you
can find out my whereabouts by calling on Mr.Zau ( 趙 ),
Room 48, Yuan Yuan Lodging House ( 源源旅館), corner of
Kiukiang and Fokien Roads. I am sure you will not disappoint
me. I am expecting your visit.

If you are engaged, you may send Mr.Moh( 麻 )
to see me on your behalf. Mr.Moh was formerly my
school-mate and fellow worker. Have you any children now?
Anyway, I know about your present conditions and also about
the literary men in our country.

Hoping you will call on me at an early date.
This is important.

Signed : Sah Koo Foo ( 薩可夫 )
(Min Min 明明 in brackets)

CDS.48
attending
page_data.zh:
致丁娜女士（Miss Ting Nah）、邮政信箱889号、日期为9月10日的信件译文。
---------

我们已有两年多未见。也许你已完全忘记了我，因为我们在学校时关系并不十分亲密。

我抵达上海后，我的朋友“肖”（Siau），《国际》一书的作者，暨中（Chi Tsoong (?)）的成员，告知了我你的地址，并告诉我你对中国现代文学感兴趣，而我对此略知一二，因此我非常渴望就此主题进行一次畅谈。我没有固定住所，但你可以通过拜访赵先生（Mr. Zau），地址为九江路与福建路拐角处的源源旅馆（Yuan Yuan Lodging House）48号房间，来查明我的行踪。我相信你不会让我失望。我期待你的来访。

如果你有事忙碌，可以派麻先生（Mr. Moh）代表你来见我。麻先生曾是我的同学和同事。你现在有孩子吗？无论如何，我了解你目前的状况，也了解我们国家的文人们。

希望你能早日来访。
此事重要。

签名：萨可夫（Sah Koo Foo）
（括号内注明：明明 Min Min）

CDS.48
经办

內容 我們別來提已有兩年多了吧。說不定你已完全忘記我是誰。因為
我們以前同窗讀書時也不是怎樣接近的。動身到沪時友人肖君
（國際作家同盟中的一員，你的通信友也是他告訴我的）對我說你對
於現代中國新文藝是有興趣的。同時我也很想知道一些這方
面的情形。因此我很希望和你面晤一次以便暢談一切。我現住一
空住房你來時可先到二馬路石路口源源館記旅館四十八号房間姓
趙的地方探問便知道我的所在。我相信你是不会失約的我是怎樣的
盼望你到來呵。如你有事不便來時可請麻君代表。我和他也是令學而
且令過事呢。你們倆結婚後已生小孩沒有？！总之我很想知道你們夫
妻倆的近况和國內文壇的消息。專此向好。
早日踐約駕臨切要至要
立薩可夫（明之）九月十日
